OrgPermissionKey.description:
- `user:read`: List the users of the organization (GET /users)
- `user:create`: Create a user with a temporary password (POST /users)
- `user:write`: Change another user's role, name or active flag (PATCH /users/{id})
- `user:reset-password`: Set a temporary password for a user and end the user's sessions (POST /users/{id}/reset-password)
- `organization-role:write`: Change what a role may do in the organization (PATCH /organization-roles/{id})
- `tank:create`: Create a tank (POST /tanks)
- `tank:write`: Rename, activate or deactivate a tank (PATCH /tanks/{id})
- `reading:create`: Record and sync water readings (POST /readings/sync)
- `reading:read-all`: Reserved: see every reading of the organization (no endpoint uses it yet)
